text: Assumption: ara::core::StringView performs no runtime check as to whether the referenced character memory is still allocated, such that the caller guarantees its lifetime — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: ara::core::StringView performs no runtime check as to whether the referenced character memory is still allocated, such that the caller guarantees its lifetime — is this correct?
norm: ara core stringview performs no runtime check as to whether the referenced character memory is still allocated such that the caller guarantees its lifetime
assumption: ara::core::StringView performs no runtime check as to whether the referenced character memory is still allocated, such that the caller guarantees its lifetime.
rationale: The absence of a memory management mechanism follows from the non-owning pointer approach (SWS_CORE_02102).

original.text: Annahme: Zeigergültigkeit: ara::core::StringView führt vermutlich keine Laufzeitprüfung durch, ob der referenzierte Zeichenspeicher noch allokiert ist, sodass der Aufrufer für dessen Lebensdauer bürgt — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Zeigergültigkeit: ara::core::StringView führt vermutlich keine Laufzeitprüfung durch, ob der referenzierte Zeichenspeicher noch allokiert ist, sodass der Aufrufer für dessen Lebensdauer bürgt.
original.rationale: Aus dem nicht-besitzenden Zeigeransatz (SWS_CORE_02102) folgt das Fehlen eines Speicherverwaltungsmechanismus.
